lines: Three of them through those schoolbooks and the third name still in pencil,
because she has not decided whether she is stopping.
Neither have I, and I am the one paying for it.
That chalk line on the floor was my joke, in the year thirty.
Somebody rubbed a bit of it out last week and nobody has mentioned it.
That is how a family gets bigger. Quietly, and by not mentioning it.
Five Crests. Five. And you are my age.
I have the chart on the shelf and the dates written next to five of the Halls
and I have not left this district once. Right. Right.
I have the route planned. Briarbell first, then the quarry, then the coast.
Everybody in this city has a route planned.
About four of us a year actually go.
